purpose: Family-specific model comparison and diagnostic experiments after the 2025-26 reports have already been inspected. This is chronological development evidence, never a new untouched holdout.

score_policy.primary: per-event log-loss within each declared family
score_policy.secondary: half-scaled categorical Brier or binary Brier; never compare raw scores across distinct families
score_policy.calibration: per-class and per-family reliability with Wilson uncertainty; logit slope/intercept descriptive only
score_policy.stronger_comparators: Every candidate compares against population and the strongest named simple comparator on exactly the same events

release: No automatic live promotion; candidate selection requires all fixed comparators and later checks, then independent prospective shadow evidence and an admission receipt. Any family without evidence remains unvalidated.
